headline: In Tyup district, 10 hectares of arable land transferred for construction of mortgage housing
summary: The Kyrgyz cabinet moved 10 hectares of irrigated arable land in Tyup district, Issyk-Kul region, into the settlement land category. The plot is slated for construction of mortgage housing.
why: Changes in land classification from farmland to residential use determine where housing construction can proceed. Such decisions affect the supply of building land and the mortgage housing market in Kyrgyzstan.
original_headline: В Тюпском районе 10 гектаров пашни перевели под строительство ипотечного жилья
